scope: Four complete supplied essays in eight languages, with targeted editorial and scientific corrections. Original source folder and ZIPs unchanged.

review.method: Read all four Simplified Chinese arguments and check correction sites, selected examples, headings and conclusions across languages. This is targeted scientific/editorial review, not exhaustive independent verification of every assertion.
review.originals: All 32 imported texts checked byte for byte against supplied Markdown files / ZIP members and stored SHA-256. The two EP18 Chinese files differ in punctuation, not lexical content; the consistently named 白垩纪末 file was selected.
corrections: EP17: correct the direction of negative evidence for feather color; distinguish non-melanin pigments from structural blues; missing yellow is not evidence for brown; measurement precision alone does not settle anatomical placement; visual reconstructions can display uncertainty; qualify Cambrian melanosome similarity.

EP18: distinguish shared-material seasonal proxies from independent studies; correct 2017 sulfur uncertainty to ±130 Gt, five North American 2025 sampling sites, and sulfur-comparison magnitude; correct inoceramid terminology in Simplified Chinese; qualify stratigraphic adjacency, climate rate/total interactions and Poisson sampling assumptions. Counterfactual inference can improve despite lack of a second Earth. Match the title to causal apportionment, not blanket unknowability.

EP19: restore the rate term d≈2rt; qualify coalescent direction against later gene flow; state independent constant-probability sampling assumptions; priors are not inherently hidden or untestable; correct short-fuse model and Late Permian/Triassic age scope in Simplified Chinese; distinguish cross-study contrasts from controlled calibration experiments; acknowledge Juramaia age/provenance as well as phylogenetic placement; joint models can improve estimates but do not remove unmodeled biases.
EP19–20: the 2023 placental study used 37 soft-bounded calibrations for 65-taxon locus trees and 23 additional calibrations in the concatenated 241-species analysis; do not conflate these.

EP20: correct crater-recognition chronology; marsupials have functional placentas and not all have pouches; newborn maturity varies; many rather than all Paleocene lineages left no living descendants; distinguish placental diversification from mammalian origins; 1700-fold growth is 3.23 orders; scope 17 tonnes to historical estimates, not a fixed ceiling; giant filter-feeding bony fishes predate whales; Panama intensified earlier dispersal; tooth isotopes reflect formation intervals, not lifetime menus; selective survival depends on environment, not intrinsic superiority.
All four: keep the full eight-section development and paragraph structure, with episode-specific closing paragraphs in place of a mechanically repeated refrain.
review.references: Selected primary research sources are linked under each article; see references.json.
review.completeness: All eight sections and nonempty paragraph counts retained. Minimum reviewed/original character ratio 0.9996; quantitative checks support but do not replace reading. Trailing blank lines are ignored by paragraph-count tests, not substantive paragraphs.

verification.structural: scripts/test_paleontology.py: 4 tests passed; full text, immutable sources, reproducibility, language metadata, publication dates, internal links, taxonomy, discovery and grouping.
verification.regression: EP01–15 byte-identical to pre-batch HEAD; EP16 changes only next-essay navigation. Unrelated search records and all prior update entries unchanged. Existing article publication dates and unchanged sitemap lastmods preserved.
verification.discovery: 32 added search source records and 32 new sitemap URLs; 168 series HTML pages, 21 per language.
verification.browser: 504 page/viewport cases passed at 375/768/1440 px: heading visibility, eight-language menus, TOC anchors and no horizontal overflow. Library/Latest language-aware links and no-JS English-to-Japanese navigation passed; zero page errors. Grouped hub, English EP17 desktop and Traditional Chinese EP20 mobile screenshots visually inspected without overlap.
